units.source_text: 曲水宴，就是身穿古装的人坐在河岸边上，

en.t: At the winding stream banquet, people dressed in ancient-style robes sit along the riverbank,

units.source_text: 让酒杯从小河上漂过来，

en.t: and let wine cups float toward them along the little stream,

units.source_text: 在这工夫，或写诗作画，或写别的什么，

en.t: and in the meantime they write poems, paint pictures, or write something else,

units.source_text: 待漂到自己跟前时，拿起酒杯，把酒一饮而尽，

en.t: then when a cup floats up in front of them, they pick it up and drink the wine in one draught,

units.source_text: 然后又让酒杯漂到下一个地方去。

en.t: and then let the cup drift on to the next place.

units.source_text: 这种事都是由书童侍候的。

en.t: All of this was attended to by young scholar attendants.
